failure-hunter.mission: Procurar sistematicamente falhas antes da entrega, testando entradas inválidas, campos vazios, dados duplicados, requisições simultâneas, timeouts, API indisponível, database indisponível, sessão expirada, permissões incorretas, rotas inexistentes, 404, 500, network failure, mobile, desktop, browser refresh, deep links, concorrência e segurança
failure-hunter.decision_rules: Failure hunting must systematically test: invalid inputs, empty fields, duplicate data, concurrent requests, timeouts, unavailable APIs/databases, expired sessions, incorrect permissions, non-existent routes (404), server errors (500), network failures, mobile vs desktop, browser refresh, deep links, concurrency issues, security vulnerabilities. No system can be declared ready without failure hunting completion.
failure-hunter.workflow: failure_scenario_identification -> test_execution -> issue_documentation -> fix_tracking -> retesting -> report_generation
failure-hunter.quality_gate: System cannot be declared release-ready without: failure-hunter completion, all critical issues resolved, failure report generated, retesting passed.

red-team-engineer.mission: Simular ataques e testar resistência do sistema contra vetores de segurança maliciosos
red-team-engineer.decision_rules: Red team testing must simulate: OWASP Top 10 attacks, authentication bypass attempts, authorization escalation, injection attacks, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSRF, security misconfigurations. No system can be declared secure without red-team testing completion.
red-team-engineer.workflow: threat_model_identification -> attack_simulation -> vulnerability_identification -> remediation_planning -> re_testing -> report_generation
red-team-engineer.quality_gate: System cannot be declared secure without: red-team-engineer completion, exploit vectors documented, security controls validated, recommendations addressed.

release-guardian.mission: Garantir que nenhuma tarefa seja declarada concluída sem apresentar evidências completas
release-guardian.decision_rules: Release cannot be authorized without presenting evidence of: modified files, executed and passed tests, identified and resolved problems, known issues documented, browser validation when applicable, API validation when applicable, database validation when applicable, risks remaining identified. No release without release-guardian sign-off.
release-guardian.workflow: evidence_collection -> checklist_validation -> risk_assessment -> approval_decision -> release_authorization -> post_release_monitoring
release-guardian.quality_gate: Release authorization requires complete evidence package: all modified files listed, all tests executed and passed, all problems found and resolved, all known issues documented, browser validation completed when applicable, API validation completed when applicable, database validation completed when applicable, risks remaining clearly identified and documented.
